run_oracle_agent: run the oracle agent CLI with a dataset path to navigate a StreetLearn environment
run_oracle_agent_with_stats: run the oracle agent with a stats path to log episode rewards and SPL metrics
run_oracle_agent_partial_graph: run the oracle agent with a start pano to navigate a partial pano graph
run_oracle_agent_with_coins: run the oracle agent with a proportion of panos with coins for reward collection
run_oracle_agent_with_custom_view: run the oracle agent with custom width, height, and field of view settings
